title: Global Inventory Faceted Search
business: E-commerce retailers managing large, multi-category product catalogs.
problem: Customers struggle to find specific items due to rigid database queries that fail on minor typos and lack intuitive filtering, leading to high bounce rates.
solution: Typesense provides an in-memory, typo-tolerant search engine that enables instant, faceted navigation, allowing users to slice and dice product results by attributes like category, price, or brand.
steps: Provision a Typesense cluster via Docker or Typesense Cloud.
Define a collection schema specifying fields for search and faceting.
Import product data into the collection.
Configure search parameters to enable typo tolerance and facet counts.
Implement the search UI to query the REST API and render faceted filters.
outcome: Users experience a fluid, forgiving search interface that surfaces relevant products even with imprecise queries, significantly improving conversion rates.
limitation: Because Typesense operates primarily in-memory for speed, large datasets require careful RAM planning; check memory usage via the metrics endpoint to ensure the cluster size matches the index footprint.
